def split_total(total_cents, n):
    """Split an amount of money in cents between n people."""
    if n <= 0:
        raise ValueError("n must be positive")
    sign = -1 if total_cents < 0 else 1
    base, leftover = divmod(abs(total_cents), n)
    return [sign * (base + (1 if i < leftover else 0)) for i in range(n)]
